searchText: As agreed upon on ACD last week, I've put up a PR for a placeholder spec for Arrow Glacier: https://github.com/ethereum/execution-specs/pull/362 Nothing too controversial, as it's still empty, so will merge in the next 24hrs unless there's a strong objection 👍 Does this mean we decided not to call the November/December fork Shanghai? 😢 Yes 🙂 People are referring to "features being included into Shanghai", so we can have the first post-merge feature fork called Shanghai (or deal with renaming it post-merge). This makes it clear the features won't happen pre-merge.
